acceptanceCriteria: Fresh 390x844 browser launch passes the knife projection containment assertion without debug controls.
The initial target and critical HUD remain visible and readable at the same viewport.
Desktop natural journey and finish-wall branch remain passing after the correction.
A Playwright natural trace and screenshot cover the exact mobile startup matrix cell.
pnpm lint, pnpm typecheck, pnpm test, pnpm build and pnpm qa:browser all pass after repair.
If the fix introduces camera state changes, they are documented as required by this game's applicability profile, not generalized to all factory games.
